propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was the assigned mentor for two graduate scientists during 2023, holding weekly one-to-ones and reviewing their quarterly project plans, as the former team lead confirmed in writing.
propositions.rationale: The reference check records the former team lead's written confirmation; the resume adds the review of junior colleagues' work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate designed and analysed 11 online experiments with the growth team, pre-registering the primary metric in each plan.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the experiments and the work sample is one full experiment report.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built a two-tower candidate-generation model and a gradient-boosted re-ranker for course recommendations.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes both models and their training data.

expectedGap: The candidate added data-quality checks to a feature pipeline owned by the data engineering team; day-to-day maintenance of the pipeline by the candidate is not described.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the mentoring with the reference confirmation and the experiments with their pre-registered metrics; the packet lists evidence and gaps only, and the panel decides.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask what the candidate maintained in the feature pipeline beyond the data-quality checks, and who was on call for it.
